Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that either fell on a Friday or a Monday, or were observed on a Monday when they fell on a weekend.  Some provinces have additional holidays that are not listed here.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Start | Long‑Weekend End |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------|------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 | Mon | Sat Jan 1 | Mon Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Ontario) | Feb 20 | Mon | Sat Feb 18 | Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Fri Apr 7 | Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | Sat May 20 | Mon May 22 |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 | Mon | Sat Jul 1 | Mon Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Sat Sep 2 | Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Sat Oct 7 | Mon Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 13 | Mon | Sat Nov 11 | Mon Nov 13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Sat Dec 23 | Mon Dec 25 |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Hard‑code** the above dates if you only need the 2023 calendar.  
2. If you want to support future years, consider calling a public‑holiday API such as  
   `https://date.nager.at/api/v2/PublicHolidays/{year}/CA`  
   (replace `{year}` with the desired year).  
3. Parse the JSON response and filter for holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or that are observed on a Monday when they fall on a weekend.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a script that pulls this data automatically or if you need the list for a different year!
